name: Goods and Services Tax (GST), 2017
change: Introduced a unified indirect tax system replacing multiple state and central taxes to create a single national market.
impact: Simplifies taxation and improves ease of doing business, though initial implementation challenges affected small businesses. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016
change: Established a time-bound process for resolving insolvency and bankruptcy cases for companies and individuals.
impact: Improves credit discipline and recovery of bad loans, strengthening the banking system.

name: Make in India Initiative, 2014
change: Promotes domestic manufacturing through policy reforms, FDI liberalization, and ease of doing business measures.
impact: Boosts industrial growth and job creation, though manufacturing share growth has been gradual.

name: Startup India Initiative, 2016
change: Provides tax exemptions, funding support, and simplified compliance for startups.
impact: Encourages innovation and entrepreneurship, contributing to growth of India’s startup ecosystem.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, 2014
change: A nationwide financial inclusion program providing bank accounts, debit cards, and insurance to unbanked populations.
impact: Expands access to financial services and enables direct benefit transfers, improving economic participation. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Demonetization Policy, 2016
change: High-value currency notes were withdrawn overnight to reduce black money, counterfeit currency, and promote digital transactions.
impact: Increased digital payments and formalization of the economy, but caused severe short-term disruption in cash-dependent sectors, especially agriculture and small businesses.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, 2020
change: Provides financial incentives to companies based on incremental production in sectors like electronics and manufacturing.
impact: Encourages domestic production and attracts global investment, boosting manufacturing competitiveness.

name: National Infrastructure Pipeline, 2019
change: A large-scale investment plan covering sectors like transport, energy, and urban infrastructure.
impact: Drives economic growth and job creation through infrastructure development.

name: Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan, 2020
change: Economic stimulus package focusing on self-reliance, MSME support, and domestic manufacturing during COVID-19 recovery.
impact: Supports economic recovery and promotes domestic industries, though long-term outcomes depend on execution.

name: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Liberalization Policy, 2015
change: Relaxation of FDI norms across sectors like defense, retail, and aviation to attract foreign investment.
impact: Increases capital inflow and global integration of the Indian economy, supporting growth and job creation. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

name: Bank Nationalisation Policy, 1969
change: Major private banks were nationalized to expand credit access to agriculture, small industries, and rural areas.
impact: Improved financial inclusion and rural banking access, but later led to inefficiencies and rising non-performing assets.
